glosses: confession (admittance of having done something, good, bad or neutral)
confession (the disclosure of one's sins to a priest for absolution)
creed (a declaration of one's religious faith)

examples.en: I have a confession to make.

examples.text: Ils la forcèrent à la confession.
Je ne fais pas de confessions sur l'oreiller.
Les confessions obtenues par la torture sont en général sans valeur.
examples.en: Confessions obtained by torture are generally worthless.
